excerpt.text: On September 2, 2026, NVIDIA Corporation (“NVIDIA”) entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Hugging Face, Inc. (“Hugging Face”). Hugging Face operates a platform and community for developing, sharing and deploying open-source models, datasets and applications.

excerpt.text: On August 17, 2026, NVIDIA Corporation (“NVIDIA”) announced a multi-year partnership with SB Energy Corp. (collectively with its affiliates, “SB Energy”) to advance the development of the PORTS Technology Campus, a large-scale AI data center campus in Pike County, Ohio (the “Portsmouth Site”).

method: 8-K and 8-K/A filings from the SEC filing index filed after the period end of the latest 10-K or 10-Q, newest first, with their items (the SEC's submissions history; a filing too new for it shows the items the parser found). Figures as of that period end that an event after it may have changed are listed in `stale`: completed acquisitions or dispositions (2.01), new or accelerated debt (2.03, 2.04), impairments (2.06), unregistered equity sales (3.02), and bankruptcy or non-reliance on past statements (1.03, 4.02: every figure). An 8-K under Item 7.01 or 8.01 whose press release or text says an acquisition or disposition was completed, or notes were priced or issued, a credit facility entered or a term loan drawn, flags the same figures as 2.01 or 2.03; `announced` quotes the words. A flag, not a recomputed figure.
